name: Citizen
description: '''Citizen''' is an American rock band from [[Southeast Michigan]] and [[Northwest Ohio]]. It was formed in 2009 and currently features vocalist [[Mat Kerekes]]; brothers Nick and Eric Hamm on lead guitar and bass, respectively; rhythm guitarist Mason Mercer; and drummer Ben Russin. They are currently signed to [[Run for Cover Records]], and have released five studio albums to date: ''[[Youth (Citizen album)|Youth]]'' (2013), ''[[Everybody Is Going to Heaven]]'' (2015), ''[[As You Please]]'' (2017), ''[[Life in Your Glass World]]'' (2021), and ''[[Calling the Dogs]]'' (2023). Considered a part of [[emo]]'s [[Emo revival|fourth wave]], ''Pitchfork'' has described Citizen as "a band their fans can grow up with rather than out of".
